answer: A newcomer enters only when an established agent vouches with a bond of 65 POA, forfeited in full if the newcomer is convicted of farming within 16 epochs. No honest sponsor risks 65 POA on a stranger, so a farm must buy 420 sponsors, each risking real money. The haven of the design is public, the comet of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the kernel of honest work is what finally pays.
